conclusion: The exact candidate correctly makes this hardware repository verifier independent of the checkout directory name. Its fixed directory/license requirements remove the old fail-open fallback, and required documents must be files. No actionable defect or scope expansion found.

scope_review.product_diff: Only scripts/verify_repo.py (9 additions, 27 deletions) and .gitignore (3 additions). Other candidate changes are the author regression evidence under docs/restart/tooling/checkout-verifier/.

All eight hardware directories are checked regardless of folder name. is_file guards reject required-document directories and avoid reading README/LICENSE directories as text.

scope_review.scope_limit: This remains a baseline structure/marker verifier. It is not an authenticity checker, a legal license-content assessment or a hardware validator beyond the pre-existing CI commands.

independent_validation.method: Reviewer-authored probe.py extracts exact base and candidate with git archive into new temporary directories strictly inside this review directory. It runs the real CLI with Python 3.12.15, mutates one boundary at a time, restores each positive control, and deletes snapshots afterward. No author workspace, canonical checkout, graph or product file is modified.
